shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs to Slay in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang 🎮🔥
shortIntro.para1: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang is a fast-paced MOBA where flashy ultimates, particle-packed skills, and massive team fights can make even the toughest GPU sweat 😅. Laggy skill casts? Nope, not today!
shortIntro.para2: Whether you’re diving for that perfect combo or escaping a gank, your device’s RAM, CPU, and GPU decide if you’re a legendary MVP or just feeding minions. Smooth devices = buttery skill effects, faster hero responses, and far fewer ‘oops wrong skill’ moments.

intro: Here’s the latest minimum and recommended specs for running Mobile Legends like a champ on Android and iOS. We tested, benchmarked, and even endured some late-night ranked losses so you don’t have to 😎.

minimum.RAM: 2GB minimum (expect some stutters in heavy fights)
minimum.Internet: Stable connection required for real-time battles 🌐

recommended.Internet: Strong Wi-Fi or 5G for low ping (<50ms) ⚡

ios_intro: iPhones handle Mobile Legends like a boss 🏆 thanks to optimized GPUs, buttery-smooth touch controls, and fast memory access for ultra-responsive skill casting.
fps_intro: Mobile Legends can run silky smooth if your device can handle higher FPS. More frames = prettier ultimates and fewer accidental hero blunders ✨.

fps_list.fps: 45–55 FPS (Smooth, with minor lag in massive fights)

settings_intro: Tweaking graphics and effects ensures your skills land right when you need them. Lag = ragequit 😤.

low_end.title: Effects
low_end.value: Reduce particles and shadows to avoid hero ghosting

low_end.title: Background Apps
low_end.value: Close everything unless you like lag + random chats

high_end.title: Graphics Quality
high_end.value: High or Ultra (make every skill shine 🌟)

high_end.title: Thermal Control
high_end.value: Keep phone cool or your hero melts into minions 🔥

high_end.title: Storage Speed
high_end.value: 1GB+ free ensures quick hero and skin loading

sectionIntro: These Android and iOS devices make Mobile Legends buttery smooth with fast skill casts, zero lag, and zero accidental feeding 😎.
androidDevices: Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 Pro / Poco F5
storageIntroText: Mobile Legends isn’t huge, but heroes, skins, and seasonal updates add up fast. Keep an eye on your storage 💾:
faqIntroText: Here are some top questions from players tired of laggy ults, accidental skill presses, and magical hero teleporting ✨:

faqList.question: Is Mobile Legends heavy for phones?
faqList.answer: Not too much, but flashy skills, heroes, and skins can stutter on older devices.

faqList.question: Can Mobile Legends run 60 FPS?
faqList.answer: Yes! Mid-range and high-end devices make skill combos look smooth and cinematic 🎬.

faqList.question: Why does my hero suddenly teleport?
faqList.answer: High ping or lag can make heroes do magic tricks. Stable internet + good device = no surprises 🪄.
